text: Ninety-three lessons, and it ends the way a real project ends: presenting it.
Thirty seconds on the dashboard's three tiles first. Follow into a report page only when someone asks why. Show the drillthrough only if someone specifically wants territory-level detail.
Check the finished project against Lesson 84's written scope, one requirement at a time. Every row needs an answer.
The real test, the same one Chapter Eight taught: hand this to someone unfamiliar with the data, and see if they can name the single most important number in under ten seconds.
From what is Power BI to a secured, scheduled, published dashboard — that arc is the whole job. Course complete. Congratulations.
